description:
Hi! I'm a CSE student passionate about AI/ML, Data Science, Cybersecurity, and Space Technology. Our team, Orvynth, is developing SatGuardX for NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, using satellite data, AI, and statistical analysis to monitor ocean and coastal changes in the Bay of Bengal.

We're looking for collaborators interested in Python, AI/ML, GIS, remote sensing, web development, UI/UX, and environmental science. Curiosity, creativity, and teamwork matter most. Let's innovate together!
